tasks.subject: Run build.py test suite
tasks.description: delegate runs `python build.py --target-dir target/test-police` to verify fmt/clippy/tests/coverage pass and capture all failures verbatim.

tasks.subject: Scan tests for ignored/disabled/flaky patterns
tasks.description: scout searches tests/ and src/*_tests.rs for #[ignore], #[cfg(skip)], skip(), flaky sleeps, and infrastructure excuses disabling tests. Report file:line for each finding.

tasks.subject: Investigate coverage gaps
tasks.description: Run coverage, parse with parse_coverage.py --threshold 80, identify files below 80% and below 40%.
